citations.text_span: Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states: "Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis." The booking record carries day_count = 30/360, which conflicts with the documented Actual/360 basis. Please confirm whether the booking should be corrected to ACT/360, or identify the executed document provision that supports 30/360. This affects all coupon accrual amounts, so please respond before the next coupon calculation date.
triage.cited_clause: Coupon amounts accrue on a Actual/360 day count basis.
triage.rationale: Both extractors agree on unambiguous term sheet language specifying Actual/360, so the divergent booking value is the likely error.

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G03 states under "Volatility Target 10% per annum" that the underlying index targets 10% annualised volatility, but the booking record carries index_vol_target_pct = 12. Both extractors independently read 10% from the term sheet, so the booking appears to be off by 2 percentage points. Please confirm the index volatility target is 10% per annum and correct the booking, or identify the index variant or supplement that supports a 12% target.
triage.rationale: The term sheet states the volatility target unambiguously and both extractors agree on 10%, leaving the booking value of 12 as the unsupported figure.
